task.title: Package portable + NSIS from current main and run the packaged licensing and offline acceptance gates
task.objective: The license-sweep provenance fix (b2e85720) and its closeout (8ed51a0c) were verified only in the development tree; dist/win-unpacked (0.1.51, built 2026-09-18 from 7069e9e) predates them. Produce fresh portable and NSIS artifacts from the current clean main through the canonical package:portable then package:nsis pipelines, prove from the packaged app.asar that they contain the fix, then run verify:packaged-licensing, verify:packaged-walkthrough, verify:packaged-runtime, verify:portable-fresh-state, verify:offline-supply-chain and validate:offline against them. Signing-dependent cases are BLOCKED unless AWKIT_PACKAGED_LICENSE_ISSUER_KEY is explicitly set on this machine; the clean-machine VM gate is NOT RUN unless the lab is available. No strict-offline, manifest, provenance or fresh-state gate is weakened.

preserved_notes: The owner's untracked scripts/offline-benchmark/ was moved outside the repository by the owner for packaging and is restored by the owner afterwards; it is never committed, excluded or touched by this task.
Older dist/ artifacts are generated build output; the 0.1.51 portable and win-unpacked tree are superseded by the rebuild, no user-authored file is deleted.

architecture: Use scripts/package-portable.ps1 and scripts/package-per-user-installer.ps1 via npm run package:portable and npm run package:nsis; never hand-invoke electron-builder to bypass a failing gate.
Do not bump the version; the release-version workflow is not part of verification packaging.
security: Do not alter signing-key custody or set the synced-key override.
Never set AWKIT_PACKAGED_LICENSE_ISSUER_KEY on this machine; signing-dependent cases are BLOCKED when it is unset.
Do not weaken manifest, provenance, fresh-state or strict-offline gates.
compatibility: Windows PowerShell 5.1 remains the packaging host shell and no administrator rights may be required.
offline: No internet dependency, telemetry, runtime download, global Node, global Playwright or global browser may be introduced.

acceptance.description: Portable and NSIS artifacts are regenerated from the clean baseline commit, provenance names that commit with treeDirty false, and the packaged app.asar contains the license-gate cancellation source.
Every packaged licensing and offline gate is executed against the fresh artifacts and reported with its exact PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT RUN outcome.
